episodes.title: I Survived a Cult | Tales of Misfortune Season 2
episodes.description: Bek Condello tells us her story of escaping a cult. Please note that this episode features references to cults, domestic violence, sexual assault, and suicidality. If you or anyone you know may be struggling with the issues discussed in this episode, we recommend reaching out to the Cult Information and Family Support service, which you can find on https://www.cifs.org.au/ LINKS: What if the afterparty was the main event? Lucy and Nikki are hosting their biggest event EVER in Melbourne on 19 December. A secret lineup. A boiler room style, day-to-night party. Welcome to UNBOXED. You'll just have to trust us...
